name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Cut-offs, documents, export entries and the rules, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Cut-offs in the next 14 days
sections.note: The export entry is lodged before loading: 48 hours by sea and 9 hours by air unless settings say otherwise.
sections.sql: select code, customer, mode, vessel, to_char(cutoff_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') cutoff, days_to_cutoff days, coalesce(export_entry_no, case when entry_required then 'lodge by ' || to_char(entry_due_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') else 'not needed' end) export_entry, outstanding from trade.shipment_board where status = 'booked' and days_to_cutoff <= 14 order by cutoff_at

sections.title: Documents outstanding
sections.sql: select d.shipment, b.customer, d.doc_name document, d.issuer, d.status, b.days_to_cutoff days_to_cutoff from trade.shipment_docs d join trade.shipment_board b on b.id = d.shipment_id where d.status in ('missing', 'draft', 'rejected') and b.status in ('booked', 'shipped') and not (b.status = 'booked' and d.doc_type = 'BL') order by b.days_to_cutoff, d.shipment

sections.title: On the water
sections.note: Documents the customer needs to clear the goods, and whether they have them.
sections.sql: select code, customer, port_discharge, eta, days_to_eta days, case when not_sent = '' then 'all sent' else not_sent end not_sent from trade.shipment_board where status = 'shipped' order by eta

sections.title: Rule findings
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, severity, ref, subject, detail from trade.compliance_findings order by severity = 'breach' desc, rule

name: origin
title: Origin and tariff codes
subtitle: Every agreement claim, the tariff codes behind it and the evidence on file

sections.title: Claims with a problem
sections.sql: select shipment, agreement, product, product_name, coalesce(hs_code, '') hs_code, problem from trade.origin_check where problem <> '' order by shipment

sections.title: Origin evidence on file
sections.sql: select p.code, p.name, d.agreement, d.criterion, d.determined_on, d.determined_by, coalesce(d.valid_to::text, 'open') valid_to, case when d.valid_to < current_date then 'LAPSED' else '' end flag from trade.origin_determinations d join trade.products p on p.id = d.product_id order by flag desc, p.code

sections.title: Tariff codes
sections.sql: select code, name, coalesce(hs_code, 'MISSING') hs_code, hs_checked_on from trade.products where active order by hs_code nulls first, hs_checked_on nulls first

name: money
title: Credits and money owed
subtitle: Letters of credit, what customers owe, and how each one pays

sections.title: Letters of credit
sections.sql: select code, lc_number, customer, currency, amount_cents, ceiling_cents, drawn_cents, latest_shipment_on, expiry_on, next_present_by, status from trade.lc_position order by expiry_on

sections.title: Invoices owing
sections.sql: select code, customer_name customer, shipment, currency, owing_cents, owing_base_cents, due_on, days_overdue from trade.invoice_balance where status = 'open' order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: How each customer pays, last 12 months
sections.sql: select code, name, country, payment_terms, paid_invoices, avg_days_late, owing_base_cents from trade.customer_payment order by avg_days_late desc nulls last

sections.title: Trade lanes, last 12 months
sections.sql: select market, shipments, customers, fob_base_cents, net_kg, agreement_claims from trade.lanes order by fob_base_cents desc
